```
Error: Module not found: ./components/FeatureCard
```

Lee: SDK PR #982 needs an owner for final review — cc @Carla who owns the JS SDK release.
Carla: I'll review after lunch. If it's small we can merge pre-cutoff, otherwise tag for next patch.

Ben: autoscaler has one pending migration but shouldn't affect builds. No blocker from infra side.
Maya: Great. Action items: Sam finish sampleapp PR, Jordan assist CI, Kate finalize snippets, Carla review SDK PR. I'll assemble changelog entries after merges. Please add a one-line summary and impact (breaking? minimal?) in PR descriptions.
Sam: On it. @Jordan sharing the CI logs now: https://ci.example/build/7890
Jordan: Looked — it's a casing issue on mac vs linux. Quick fix in sampleapp coming.
Maya: Awesome. If anything slips past cutoff, we'll include under 'post-cutoff fixes' in the release notes. :thumbsup:
